summary:
ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the test, indicating potential issues that need immediate attention. It is recommended to investigate and resolve these issues to ensure the page performs optimally.
insights: The First Contentful Paint (FCP) for the homepage is relatively high compared to the pricing and blog pages, suggesting that the initial rendering of the homepage could be improved.

The Time to Interactive (TTI) is not provided in the test results, which is an important metric to consider when evaluating web performance. It is recommended to measure TTI for a more comprehensive understanding of user experience.
Implementing techniques such as lazy loading, code splitting, and image optimization can further improve the load times for all pages, ensuring a faster and more seamless user experience.
